verdicts.reason: Identical pattern to the fixed bug: requireAdmin sends res.status(403).json({error:'forbidden'}) inside the if without returning, so next() still executes and the forbidden request reaches the handler, likely causing a second response (ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT). No early guard, else branch, or caller-side handling prevents fall-through. The same fix applies: `return res.status(403).json(...)` (or move next() into an else).
